scope_confirmed_by_user.area: Yogyakarta-Klaten, Indonesia, as a study example
scope_confirmed_by_user.purpose: Prepare evidence and numeric inputs before application implementation

spatial_policy.climate: One representative POWER point; meteorological grid spans tens of kilometres. No claim that this equals each field's weather.
spatial_policy.soil: SoilGrids predictions over a small rural Klaten subset; not a laboratory test or verified field boundary.
spatial_policy.vegetation: MODIS composite pixels; mask clouds and quality flags; cropland screening is historical and does not confirm crop species or an individual farm.
spatial_policy.terrain: Copernicus DEM fallback must retain its source identity; a surface model is not a survey of field microtopography.
spatial_policy.gaez: Historical model baseline at 5 arc-minute support; retain categorical legend and management assumptions.
spatial_policy.fusion: Join by location, period and source support. A common map display must not imply identical source resolution or produce invented 30m field observations.

temporal_policy.recent_2026: Separate partial near-real-time series. Source latency and missing dates remain explicit.
temporal_policy.vegetation: Historical composites, not daily or necessarily cloud-free.
temporal_policy.soil_and_land_cover: Static or historical maps, not live observations.
temporal_policy.forecast: No seasonal weather forecast has been acquired or inferred from historical climatology.

unknown_policy: Missing inputs stay null/unavailable. Never substitute invented farm history, market prices, yield, nitrogen credit or profit.
